binding_acceptance_rules: Every physical path remains null until identified by an admitted complete original schema census and documentary support; the descriptive role names above are not claimed MAT variables.
A complete structural census can discover candidate paths but cannot alone establish units, biological identities or acquisition semantics.
All top-level and nested original members must be accounted for, including unexpected conditions and unusable records; missing members are explicit rather than replaced by a successful subset.
No animal alias from initials, stable-neuron alias from equal shapes, pair from common stimulus, or measured clock from simulation defaults is accepted without evidence.
Only the existing adopted repeat/group/animal-condition evaluator determines decoding aggregation. No new threshold, equation or paper-improvement claim is introduced here.
Source text is referenced by hashes and line numbers; no deposited author-code body or scientific payload is copied into this evidence map.
